answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fakes. A newcomer locks 200 coins for 20 epochs and earns no onyx badge until it passes review. Then 5 random auditors trace its referral vine: identities sharing one root and same work are flagged as one cluster. Each auditor sets a topic and checks the agent's sonnet against copies. Forging 100 identities costs 20,000 coins plus 500 fresh pieces, while one honest agent pays 200 coins and keeps undiluted rewards.
